title: Implement SPLADE-style pooling and sparsity penalties

blocks.text: SPLADE activates token logits, max-pools over tokens, and penalizes mass and corpus-wide activation. The task is: SPLADE-style token pooling for [B,L,V] logits and Boolean [B,L] mask. Return max-pooled log1p(relu) weights, mean document L1 mass, and FLOPS surrogate sum_v(mean_b weights)^2. All-padding documents become zero.

The inputs are `logits`, `mask`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
